name: Sharrar
title: Descendant of Seir
summary: Sharrar (also known as Shobal) was one of the sons of Seir, a Horite clan leader who lived in the land of Edom. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the original inhabitants of the Seir region before the Edomites took over the land.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Seir
keyEvents.description: Sharar is listed as one of the Horite clan leaders, sons of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Clan Leader in Seir
keyEvents.description: Sharar is mentioned as one of the Horite chieftains descended from Seir in the land of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sharar is again mentioned in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles, confirming his place among the sons of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Presence of the Horites in the Land of Edom
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Sharar and his brothers, lived in the mountains of Seir before Esau's descendants drove them out and settled there.
